Title: Decide demo authentication mechanism
Description: ADR 0001 open question 1; the API currently has no auth/authz (KL-001, by design for this milestone). Choose simple seeded demo users vs a real identity provider. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md, docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Decide server evidence storage: local filesystem vs object storage
Description: ADR 0001 open question 2. Today files are written under backend/var/evidence behind the EvidenceStorage adapter (backend/app/storage.py). Decide whether object storage is required from the start. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md.

Title: Decide report persistence: stored permanently vs regenerated from immutable snapshot
Description: ADR 0001 open question 3. Reports are generated server-side from a reviewed snapshot; confirm whether the artifact is retained. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md.

Title: Decide max photo size and supported image formats
Description: ADR 0001 open question 4. Current default MAX_EVIDENCE_BYTES=10485760 and uploads require image/* content type. Confirm accepted limits/formats. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md, fieldproof-starter/README.md.

Title: Accept ADR 0001 (currently Status: Proposed)
Description: ADR 0001 is marked "Proposed; confirm during Milestone 1 review". Accepting it is required before the architecture can be considered locked. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md.

Title: Add server endpoint to set checklist outcomes and per-item notes
Description: KL-002: no endpoint to set PASS/FAIL/NOT_APPLICABLE or per-item notes; items seed NOT_STARTED and the client tracks completion locally. Consequence: report summary.passed/failed is 0. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Add schema migrations (Alembic) instead of create_all
Description: KL-003: the schema is created with SQLAlchemy create_all; no migration path. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Add background/periodic automatic sync worker
Description: KL-004: sync triggers remain app-launch and manual retry. On-queue scheduling with a connected-network constraint is now implemented, but there is still no periodic worker, so evidence added while the app is open can wait for a relaunch/retry. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/acceptance-criteria.md (line 22).

Title: Decide whether the PDF embeds raw photo bitmaps
Description: KL-005: the PDF references evidence (kind, id, note snippet) and reviewer sign-off but does not embed photo bitmaps. Confirm this stays an accepted limitation or becomes future work. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Verify and mark persistence acceptance criteria (offline, process death)
Description: acceptance-criteria.md items 1–2 ("Inspection and checklist changes persist after process termination while offline"; "Photos and notes persist locally and are linked to the correct checklist item") are unmarked. demo.md cites RoomPersistenceTest/OfflineToSyncIntegrationTest as coverage; confirm and check the boxes. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Reconcile permission-denial acceptance criterion
Description: acceptance-criteria.md item "Permission denial provides actionable feedback and does not corrupt local work" is unmarked; CameraPermissionDeviceTest and demo.md Steps 7–8 describe the behaviour. Confirm coverage and mark. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Verify reviewer sign-off references a specific inspection version
Description: acceptance-criteria.md item "Reviewer sign-off references a specific inspection version" is unmarked while the PDF criterion above it is satisfied. Confirm the versioned sign-off is present/tested. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Complete loading/empty/error/success states on primary flows
Description: acceptance-criteria.md item "Loading, empty, error, and success states are present on primary flows" is unmarked. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Provide Linear access so open decisions/blockers can be filed automatically
Description: BLOCKER: no Linear CLI, API key, or MCP integration exists in the working environment, so these rows cannot be pushed to Linear from here. Options: supply LINEAR_API_KEY + team, import this CSV via Linear's importer, or paste as issues. Source: environment check.

Title: Physical-device instrumentation on MIUI ROM is blocked
Description: KL-009: a MIUI device rejected instrumented-test installs/input injection (INSTALL_GRANT_RUNTIME_PERMISSIONS on gradle install). Workaround used: manual APK install + adb shell am instrument; CI API-34 emulator lane is the supported automated path. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Backend DB tests cannot run without PostgreSQL
Description: Without TEST_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL the database-backed backend tests are skipped; there is no Postgres/Docker available in the local environment. Source: fieldproof-starter/README.md, docs/demo.md.
